summary.en: Practise midterm and final questions with worked dispatch traces and code designs.
summary.bn: মিডটার্ম আর ফাইনালের মতো প্রশ্নে মেথডের ট্রেস, কোড লেখা আর ডিজাইন অনুশীলন করো।

notes: All executable traces use Java 17 semantics, including overload selection before runtime dispatch.

sections.title: Practise reasoning under a time limit
Resolve a call in a fixed order
Explain the contract behind the mechanism
Show a request moving through the design
Review the decision that caused the mistake

practice.title: Write a timed midterm answer
practice.statementHtml: Spend ten minutes answering: explain encapsulation and implement a safe mark update for 0..100.
practice.answerHtml: Keep mark private. A setter checks the proposed value before assignment and either rejects it or returns failure without changing state. Explain one valid update and one rejected update. Private storage alone is insufficient if a public operation can violate the range.
hints: Reserve time for the rejection path.

practice.title: Trace before running
practice.statementHtml: For each inheritance trace above, record declared types, runtime types, selected signatures and print order.
practice.answerHtml: For the field/method trace: declared receiver Parent, runtime Child; field Parent.value gives 1, instance method Child.read gives 2. For the overload trace: Parent argument chooses show(Parent), regardless of its Child object. Constructor trace is Parent body, Child fields, Child body.

quiz.prompt: With a Parent reference to Child, whose instance method runs?
quiz.explanation: The selected instance method is overridden, so the receiver’s runtime class chooses Child.name.

quiz.prompt: Which declaration chooses a field while the method dispatches dynamically?
quiz.explanation: Field lookup uses the reference type; the overridden method uses the runtime receiver.

quiz.prompt: Which overloaded signature is chosen for a Parent-typed argument?
quiz.explanation: Overload resolution sees the argument’s declared Parent type.

quiz.prompt: In what order do superclass and subclass initialization messages appear?
quiz.explanation: The superclass constructor finishes before Child field initialization and constructor body.

quiz.prompt: Does reassigning a parameter change the caller’s reference?
quiz.explanation: Mutation reaches the shared object; parameter reassignment changes only the local copy.

quiz.prompt: What should you determine first in a method-invocation trace?
options: Whether the code compiles and which signature is selected
The hash code of every object
quiz.explanation: Compilation and overload selection precede runtime method dispatch.

quiz.prompt: Which member is selected without runtime overriding?
quiz.explanation: Static methods are hidden and selected from compile-time type information.

quiz.prompt: How should a correct equals override be declared?
quiz.explanation: A narrower parameter overload does not override Object.equals.

quiz.prompt: Why does a final array field still allow element changes?
quiz.explanation: Object mutability and binding reassignment are separate questions.

quiz.prompt: What does a safe downcast require for a non-null reference?
options: Only an explicit cast written in source
quiz.explanation: A cast can compile yet fail at runtime if the object has an incompatible class.

quiz.prompt: Where should validation occur in a bank-account operation?
quiz.explanation: Reject invalid requests without corrupting the object invariant.

options: Overloading is selected only at runtime
Overriding replaces an inherited instance implementation with a matching signature
quiz.explanation: Parameter lists distinguish overloads; matching inherited methods can be overridden.

quiz.prompt: Which relation suits a service holding a pricing policy?
options: Class inheritance because both have methods
quiz.explanation: A service has a policy and delegates the variable calculation.

quiz.prompt: What does a good written design answer include besides a diagram?
options: Responsibilities, constraints and a worked interaction
quiz.explanation: A design must show how objects preserve rules during use.

quiz.prompt: How should output answers represent a compile error?
options: Explain the invalid rule instead of inventing runtime output
quiz.explanation: A program that does not compile has no normal execution trace.

keyPoints.en: Resolve the selected signature before following dynamic dispatch.
keyPoints.bn: আগে কোন সিগনেচার নেওয়া হয়েছে দেখো, তারপর রানটাইমে কোন মেথড চলে তা ধরো।

keyPoints.en: Trace object fields separately from reference variables.
keyPoints.bn: অবজেক্টের ফিল্ড আর রেফারেন্স ভেরিয়েবলের মান আলাদা করে লেখো।

keyPoints.en: A design answer must explain how invariants survive operations.
keyPoints.bn: ডিজাইনের উত্তরে অপারেশনের পরও নিয়মগুলো ঠিক থাকে কীভাবে, তা বোঝাও।

keyPoints.en: Compile-time failures have no normal output trace.
keyPoints.bn: কম্পাইল না হলে স্বাভাবিক আউটপুটের ট্রেস বানিও না।

keyPoints.en: Use precise contracts when comparing Java mechanisms.
keyPoints.bn: জাভার ফিচার তুলনা করার সময় প্রতিটির নিয়ম স্পষ্ট করে লেখো।

examQuestions.question: Define class, object, state and behaviour using a course registration.
examQuestions.answerHtml: A class defines the fields and operations of a type. Each registration object has identity and its own state, such as roll and course. Its behaviour includes enrol or cancel operations. Two equal-looking objects may still have different identities.

examQuestions.question: Compare procedural and object-oriented designs for marks validation.
examQuestions.answerHtml: A procedural design passes marks data into separate functions. An object-oriented design can keep marks private and expose operations that preserve the 0..100 invariant. Both use functions and data; OOP places responsibility with the object that owns the state.

examQuestions.question: Predict the output of the field-versus-method trace in quiz question 2 and justify both values.
examQuestions.answerHtml: The output is 1 2. item.value resolves to Parent.value because the expression has declared type Parent. item.read invokes Child.read at runtime, and that body reads Child.value.

examQuestions.question: Predict the initialization trace in quiz question 4.
examQuestions.answerHtml: PFC1 is printed. Parent constructor prints P. Child field initializer calls setup, printing F and storing 1. Child constructor body prints C1 with a newline. The call does not invoke an overridable Child method from Parent construction.

examQuestions.question: Write a validated immutable Course value with code and credits.
examQuestions.answerHtml:
final class Course {
    private final String code;
    private final int credits;
    Course(String code, int credits) {
        if (code == null || code.isBlank() || credits < 1 || credits > 4) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException();
        }
        this.code = code;
        this.credits = credits;
    }
    String code() { return code; }
    int credits() { return credits; }
}

Private final fields and no mutators preserve these values after validation. String is already immutable.

examQuestions.question: Design student and staff membership without making all members borrow identically.
examQuestions.answerHtml: Give common identity to Member. Define a borrowing-limit operation with a documented nonnegative result, overridden by concrete member types or delegated to a policy. Keep Library responsible for enforcing outstanding-loan limits. Show the association from Library to members and loans.

examQuestions.question: Explain equals and hashCode requirements for an immutable roll key.
examQuestions.answerHtml: Equality must be reflexive, symmetric, transitive, consistent and false for null. Equal keys must have equal hash codes. Compare the same immutable identity fields in both methods. Hash collisions do not imply equality. A final key class avoids subclass equality asymmetry.

examQuestions.question: Give an example where composition is clearer than inheritance.
examQuestions.answerHtml: Checkout holds a DiscountPolicy interface and calls its discount method. A new policy can be supplied without subclassing Checkout. The relationship is has-a, and construction makes the dependency visible. Define what happens for invalid prices and ensure every policy obeys the same contract.

examQuestions.question: Explain checked exception propagation through three methods.
examQuestions.answerHtml: If read throws IOException, its caller must catch that checked exception or declare it. If the middle method declares it, the outer caller has the same obligation. Place recovery at the boundary that can report or retry; preserve the original cause if translating the failure.

examQuestions.question: Design a sorted report of distinct roll numbers with code-level operations.
examQuestions.answerHtml: Read valid rolls into TreeSet<Integer>. add rejects comparison-equal duplicates. Iterate the set to print ascending rolls. With n inputs, insertion costs O(log n) each and storage is O(u) for u distinct rolls. Zero inputs produce an empty report.

examQuestions.question: Explain why a generic copy uses extends for its source and super for its destination.
examQuestions.answerHtml: Read each source element as T from List<? extends T>. Write that T into List<? super T>. A source may contain a narrower subtype; a destination may hold a wider supertype. Neither declaration permits arbitrary Number objects to be inserted into an unknown Integer list.

examQuestions.question: Identify and repair a two-thread shared-counter race.
examQuestions.answerHtml: Each unsynchronized increment reads, adds and writes. Two workers can overwrite the same previous value. Synchronize the complete update on the shared counter, use the same locking policy for reads, and join both workers before printing. Volatile alone does not make ++ atomic.
